title: 🎙️ “He began preaching truth — but when the applause rose, his voice changed. Every false prophet starts as a truth-teller who couldn’t resist the spotlight.”
paragraphs: 🎙️ “He began preaching truth — but when the applause rose, his voice changed. Every false prophet starts as a truth-teller who couldn’t resist the spotlight.”

📖 Bible Verse:
“Watch out for false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.” — Matthew 7:15
